methods.notes: Reported pressure is the mean of the pressures from two ruby spheres; its uncertainty is their standard deviation. At 31.820 GPa ruby 1 was not measured and was estimated from ruby 2 with the Table 2 footnote relation.

primary_source_check.finding: The defect-normalized specimen remains metrically cubic in helium through 55.5 GPa. The authors fit all 17 cubic-cell observations with their explicitly printed BM3 equation, an ambient V0 prior, and free K0 and K0_prime.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Table 3 and page 1713: a MINUTI program fit (version 2.0) of the BM3 equation printed on page 1710 to the 17 helium cubic-cell rows of deposit Table 2.

primary_data_check.finding: All 30 Table 2 rows are bundled: one ambient observation, 17 helium observations, and 12 neon observations. Both cubic and hexagonal indexing results, all printed uncertainties, and both ruby wavelengths are retained.

published_135_8_gpa_density_benchmark.mass_basis: nominal Mg0.22Fe0.78O with Z=4, matching the source calculation

independent_refit.objective: diagnostic iteratively reweighted effective variance in pressure, sigma_eff^2 = sigma_P^2 + (dP/dV sigma_V)^2, plus the published Gaussian V0 prior
independent_refit.notes: All diagnostic coefficients are within the source's 1-sigma parameter uncertainties. The paper does not state MINUTI's exact residual objective or treatment of P-V covariance, so this diagnostic is not promoted to a Peritheos refit record.

reported_parameterizations.reason: No space group or atomic structure is established; the authors describe an increasingly hexagonal distortion correlated with nonhydrostatic stress, and the 58.7 A^3 V0 is for a three-formula-unit indexing cell rather than the four-formula-unit cubic cell.

unresolved_issues: The numerical EOS covariance matrices used for Figure 5 are not printed or deposited; parameter_covariance is therefore null.
The exact MINUTI version-2.0 residual objective, weights, and treatment of pressure-volume covariance are not stated in the article or official supplement.
The study establishes high-spin Fe2+ and tetrahedral high-spin Fe3+ at ambient pressure only; it does not resolve spin state along either compression run.

The paper's 135.8 GPa density reproduces only with the nominal Mg0.22Fe0.78O molar mass, not the defect-normalized Mg0.215Fe0.762□0.023O mass reported from the same study. This benchmark is retained as a source calculation, not used to redefine the material composition.

superseded_record_text.notes: Canonical equilibrium-oriented record. V0 is fitted under a 78.94 +/- 0.1 A^3 ambient prior rather than fixed; K0 and K0_prime are freely varied. Parenthetical values are the source's 1-sigma fit uncertainties, stored with null confidence because they are standard errors rather than interval half-widths. The 300 K reference is nominal room temperature and no row-wise temperature observations are reported.
validity_notes: Empirical nominal-300 K cubic compression curve through the helium data range plus its zero-pressure reference; the bounds are not a phase-stability guarantee.
The crystal remains metrically cubic through 55.5 GPa, but spin state was measured only at room pressure before loading and is unresolved under compression.
Helium is the more hydrostatic baseline, although the article cites gradual nonhydrostaticity in helium above about 23 GPa.

superseded_record_text.notes: Published stress-sensitive low-pressure neon alternative. V0 and K0_prime were constrained by priors, not fixed, so fixed_parameters is empty. The authors attribute the stiffer curve relative to helium to neon crystallization and nonhydrostaticity; this record is intentionally not the default. Parenthetical values are 1-sigma fit uncertainties.
validity_notes: Empirical nominal-300 K low-pressure cubic-indexing fit plus its zero-pressure reference; it is not an equilibrium recommendation.
Neon crystallizes near 4.8 GPa, and the authors state that the unit-cell volume is affected below the approximately 20 GPa onset of resolvable hexagonal distortion.
Do not extrapolate this stress-sensitive fit into the high-pressure distorted branch.
